I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states one paragraph: TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no development-only exemption. It also says the latest recorded decision requires HTTPS everywhere, with no exceptions.

The paragraph rests on two recorded decisions: "verification on all builds" (#21) and "https everywhere, no exceptions" (#24). I left out the earlier development-build setting that #21 replaced. I did not open the plain-HTTP-for-internal-hosts note (an episode, #22), because it isn't a recorded decision and the newer #24 says no exceptions.
